== Title ==
<span lang="ja">デス・スター・ドッキング・コントロール・ルーム327</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しており、なおかつここに能力値＞2の反乱軍が配備されているなら、フォース消耗は＋2される。</span>

'''Dark Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、リザーブデッキの中から直接ドッキング・ベイを取り出して配備することができる。その後でリザーブデッキはシャッフルする。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Death Star: Docking Control Room 327.

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. If you control this site and a Rebel with ability greater than 2 is deployed here, Force drain is +2. Dark Side. If you control, you may deploy a docking bay directly from the Reserve Deck. Shuffle the Reserve Deck afterward.

The Japanese face omits the Scomp link icons shown on the original English face. Its Light Side text says the Rebel is deployed here. The English original says the Rebel is present.<ref>[[:File:P2P-D-deathstardockingcontrolroom327-printed-scan.png|Original English face]], [[Death Star: Docking Control Room 327]].</ref>
